answer_1.quote: We apply the proposed approach to language modeling, unaligned style transfer and dialog-response generation.

answer_2.quote: Evaluation Metrics. To benchmark language modeling performance, we report the ELBO and Perplexity (PPL) of APo-VAE and baselines.

answer_4.quote: We further perform human evaluation via Amazon Mechanical Turk.
answer_4.guideline: we asked the turkers to compare generated responses from two models, and assess each model's informativeness, relevance to the dialog context (coherence), and diversity.
